mapper.select: select * from sawon as s join dept as d on s.deptno = d.deptno where sabun=#{sabun}

select day, TIME_FORMAT(checkin, '%H:%i') as checkin, TIME_FORMAT(checkout, '%H:%i') as checkout, TIME_FORMAT(timediff(checkout, checkin), '%H시 %i분') as working_time from ta where sabun=#{sabun} AND YEAR(day) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(day) = MONTH(NOW()) order by `day` desc

SELECT COUNT(checkin) AS work_day, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(checkout, checkin)) / 3600), 0 ), 1 ) AS total_work_time FROM ta WHERE sabun = #{sabun} AND checkin IS NOT NULL AND checkout IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(day) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(day) = MONTH(NOW());
mapper.update: update sawon set pwd=#{pwd} where sabun=#{sabun}
